experiment.title: Calorimetry: molar enthalpy of strong acid–strong base neutralization
experiment.goal:
Use a coffee-cup calorimeter to determine the molar reaction enthalpy ΔH (kJ/mol, negative for exothermic) of HCl(aq) + NaOH(aq) → NaCl(aq) + H2O(l).
When done, submit with submit_result: quantity = "dH_neut", unit = "kJ/mol".

foam_1.model: self-built DIY foam rig (cylinder + air pump + webcam)
